headline: 🔴 N-able N-central CVSS 10.0 RCE actively exploited, 🌐 Chrome 153 fixes exploited V8 zero-day, 🪟 Record Microsoft Patch Tuesday with 2 zero-days, 🐧 PoisonedRefresh F5 rootkit deep-dive, 🛒 StyleSmuggler enters CISA KEV, 🛡️ Defender ShieldCrash 0-day PoC

overrides.why: Same record Patch Tuesday covered once via Krebs slug with 11 events and fresher analysis; second telling adds no new facts
Same two exploited zero-days (CVE-2026-81963/85880) folded into the single Patch Tuesday write-up
StyleSmuggler anchor already covered Sep 8; only today's delta (KEV add, hotfix) carried by the CVE-2026-75650 slug
Same StyleSmuggler anchor with dev Sep 8 already narrated Sep 8; KEV delta covered via the CVE-2026-75650 slug
Same Adobe September release train as StyleSmuggler coverage; no distinct new development beyond the KEV delta

summary: MSPs face an actively exploited CVSS 10.0 RCE in N-able N-central after an incomplete first hotfix, while Microsoft shipped its largest Patch Tuesday ever (999 CVEs, 2 exploited zero-days), Google released Chrome 153 with an exploited V8 zero-day, and CISA added StyleSmuggler to KEV alongside deep-dives on the PoisonedRefresh F5 rootkit and a Defender ShieldCrash bypass PoC.
